# Vendored packages

`hdhub-bodygraph-3d-0.1.1.tgz` is maintained by the repository owner and is
vendored to keep clean installs reproducible after the former Nexus registry
became unavailable.

The public `@hdhub/bodygraph-3d@1.0.0` release requires `Hdhub3dProvider` and a
runtime API key, so it is not a drop-in replacement for this static portfolio.
